title: 【沪教】八上英语阅读理解之记叙文18篇.pdf

questions.stem: What is Libby’s favourite subject?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Libby loves science, especially chemistry.”可知，Libby 最喜欢的科目是化学。 故选C。

questions.stem: Which experiments did the girls choose to do at the science station?
opts: Making big bubbles, mixing soft slime, and launching a rocket.
Making big bubbles, mixing hard slime, and launching a rocket.
Making small bubbles, mixing soft slime, and launching a paper plane.
Making small bubbles, mixing hard slime, and launching a paper plane.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“They picked three favourite experiments for the festival-making big bubbles (泡 泡), mixing soft slime (史莱姆), and launching a rocket”可知，女孩们选择的实验是制作大泡泡、混合 软史莱姆和发射火箭。故选A。

questions.stem: How did Libby feel when they lost?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Libby felt sad.”可知，当她们输了时，Libby 感到不开心。故选D。

questions.stem: What kind of person is Mr. Darwin?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“That DOESN’T mean we can’t be proud of how hard you tried. We can have our OWN ice-cream party!”和Mr. Darwin 对女孩们的支持和鼓励可知，他是一个很乐于助人的人。故选 B。 5. 主旨大意题。本文作者通过女孩们实验失败但不气馁，并勇敢面对挫折的故事，告诉我们犯错 并不可怕，我们可以从错误中收获新的想法和成长。故选D。

questions.stem: What is the most important lesson to learn from this story?【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之记叙文(18 篇)(
opts: Working together is the key to success.
Don’t do experiments without a teacher’s help.
Remember to clean up after doing an experiment.
Making mistakes gives us new ideas and helps us grow.
questions.expl: 本文作者通过女孩们实验失败但不气馁，并勇敢面对挫折的故事，告诉我们犯错并不可怕， 我们可以从错误中收获新的想法和成长。

questions.stem: After the poor man came to the writer’s home, the mother ________.
opts: invited him to have some coffee
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Later, my mother came back and handed him a sandwich made from homemade bread and generous pieces of boiled meat. She also gave him a bottle of milk.”可知，母亲提供给他食物。 故选D。

questions.stem: Which of the following can best fit in the ▲?
opts: They said your mama would feed me.
I would like to come to play with you again.
It’s kind of you to let me stay here for one night.
We will ask Jenny’s mother to feed us, too.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Jenny had said all the homeless men told each other who would feed them.”以及 “‘They never come to my house!’ she had said proudly and happily.”说明流浪汉会告诉同伴哪些家庭会 给他们食物，因此，他走出时很可能说的是“They said your mama would feed me.”。故选A。

questions.stem: The order of the story is ________.a. My mother communicated with the poor manb. I understood my mother after talking to her.c. I played at the gate and watched the poor man having food.d. I opened the gate to let the poor man get in the yard.e. The poor man stood up and walked back through the gate.
questions.expl: 理解。根据“I nodded and opened the gate to let him get in the yard”，“When my mother appeared, he asked, ‘Lady, could you spare something to eat?’”，“I played at the gate, watching the man wolf down the sandwich and empty the cup.”，“After finishing the food, he stood up and walked back through the gate”和“I seemed to find out the answer to my question and understand that.”可知，故事情节顺序：d. 我 打开栅栏让穷人进来；a. 我妈妈和穷人交流；c. 我在栅栏边玩，看穷人吃东西；e. 穷人站起来往 回走；b. 与妈妈交流后我理解了她。故选D。

questions.stem: The underlined word “that” in the last paragraph refers to ________.
opts: the question that Jenny didn’t know before
the fact that Jenny’s family wouldn’t let the poor men in
the reason why the mother fed the poor man
the talk between the mother and the writer
questions.expl: 本文讲述了一位小女孩在与一位贫穷的流浪汉接触后，通过观察和与母亲的交流，理解了 【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之记叙文(18 篇)(

questions.stem: What did the author think the blind woman wanted at first sight?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Naturally, I reached into my pocket for some change immediately and placed it in her hand without even looking at her.”可知，作者认为那个女人是想要钱，故选C。

questions.stem: Why did the author feel ashamed?
opts: Because he couldn’t face the woman.
Because he was an immigrant himself.
Because he had prejudice on the woman.
Because he didn’t judge the woman by her appearance.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“I had acted with prejudice (偏见). I felt ashamed of myself and couldn’t face the old woman anymore.”可知，作者感到羞愧，因为他对那个女人有偏见。故选C。

questions.stem: Why did the author mention his experience as a busboy?
opts: To show he was a poor boy.
To tell he didn’t work hard at school.
To prove he used to be a humble man.
To show he used to be judged unequally.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Through the years, I have experienced many acts of prejudice. I remember a time when I was a busboy, I heard a father tell his little boy that if he did not do well in school, he would end up like me.”可知，作者提到自己做勤杂工的事情是为了表明他曾经受到不公平的评价。故选D。

questions.stem: What does the underlined sentence mean?
opts: The woman helped the author get eyesight back.
The woman taught the author some professional knowledge.
The woman made the author realize the importance of being humble.
The woman enabled the author to live an American middle-class lifestyle.
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据上文“‘So why does Mama feed the poor man?’ I wondered. I walked inside. ‘Jenny’s mama says those men are too lazy to work. Why do we feed them?’”可知，此处的that 指的是 作者的疑问“为什么妈妈要给流浪汉食物”，故选C。

questions.stem: Which is the best title for the text?
questions.expl: 本文讲述了作者因把一位盲人女士的求助误认为是乞讨行为，从而反思自己不应该带着偏 见看人的故事。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “this” refer to in Paragraph 2?
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据第一段“Most of the world’s progress is made by the few pioneers who break barriers, reach new distances, and find a new path” 世界上大部分的进步都是由少数突破障碍、达到新 距离、找到新道路的先驱者取得的；可知，“this”指代第一段提到的先驱者行为。故选B。

questions.stem: What do we know about Roger Bannister?
opts: He wanted others to follow him.
He received support from his family.
He made a great achievement in running.
He collected evidence to support himself.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第二段“A powerful example of this is Roger Bannister, who in 1954, broke the four-minute mile barrier with a record of 3 minutes, 59.4 seconds.”可知，他在跑步方面取得了突破。故 选C。 3. 推理判断题。根据第三段“It was not that these runners had improved physical qualities from the runners who had tried and failed before them, …They had proof of the possible”可知，第三段提到其他 跑者“证明可能”，旨在说明先驱者的突破为后人提供心理动力，凸显先驱者的重要性。故选B。

questions.stem: Why are “other runners” mentioned in Paragraph 3?【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之记叙文(18 篇)(
opts: To show the bravery of other runners.
To show the importance of pioneers.
To show the power of following others.
To show the importance of physical qualities.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“He worried that the young men wouldn’t have the patience to learn”以及“You have begun to learn”可知专家认为学习要有耐心，所以他让年轻人拿着玉石好几天，可推知此处专 家应让年轻人有点耐心，会学到东西的，选项B“你会学到的”符合语境。故选B。

questions.stem: What does the writer advise the readers to do in the last paragraph?
questions.expl: 本文通过Roger Bannister 打破“四分钟一英里”障碍的实例，阐述先驱者突破传统认知、开 辟新路径的重要性。

questions.stem: How long did the man hold the jade stone without asking anything?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“On the third, fourth, and fifth day the expert repeated the action. ”和“On the sixth day the young man still had to hold the jade stone, but he could no longer stand the silence”可知，年轻人 握着翡翠石头五天而什么都没问。故选B。

questions.stem: Why did the expert ask the man to hold a stone for days?
opts: It was a way of learning.
He was too busy to teach the man.
It was the most valuable gem he had.
There was no other work for the man to do.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“The young man asked the expert many times to let him have a try”以及“You have begun to learn,”可知，专家让年轻人好几天都握着一块石头，因为那也是一种学习方式。故选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following can be put in the▲?
opts: It is all that I could give you
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“‘Who wears the trousers in your family?’ means ‘Who’s the head of your family?’” 结合题干“杰瑞的妈妈几乎决定家里的一切”，可知，她是家里的决策者。故选C。

questions.stem: How did the young man’s feeling change?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据前文“This reminded me that I believed in being humble (谦逊的), even though I had lost that belief for a moment.”以及“It is the blind woman who cured me of my blindness.”可知，这件 事提醒了作者要谦虚，尽管他一度失去了这个信念。因此划线句子中作者把带有偏见的自己形容成 失明的人，而这个女人让作者意识到谦卑的重要性。故选C。

questions.stem: What does the passage mainly tell us?
questions.expl: 本文讲述一个年轻人向专家求教的故事。故事揭示了耐心在学习中的重要性。

questions.stem: The writer’s mother read the old records and visited libraries to ________.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“She felt embarrassed.”可知，她非常尴尬，B 图片符合。故选B。

questions.stem: We can infer (推断) that _________.
opts: the writer doesn’t really like his teaching job in Russia
every family in Russia is the same with five people
some people might never stop when talking about family stories
one of the writer’s great-grandfathers liked travelling
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“I’m the traveler in my family, and I love travelling. I always think I got it from a great-grandfather. ”可知，作者的一位曾祖父喜欢旅行。故选D。

questions.stem: Jerry’s mother decides almost everything in the family, so ________.
opts: she is the black sheep of the family
her blood is thicker than water
she wears the trousers in the family
she is the breadwinner of the family
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“But because of the added weight, she was not able to fly.”可知，鹳飞不起来是因 为她又在爪子上多缠绕了绷带，增加了重量。故选B。

questions.stem: If we put the passage into four parts, which one is the best?
questions.expl: 本文是一篇记叙文，作者通过个人教学经历和家族历史探索，阐述了家庭并非千篇一律， 而是充满独特故事、历史记忆和文化传承的载体。文章最终回归语言教学，强调用丰富的习语来谈 论家庭，更能体现家庭的个性与深度。

questions.stem: What might be the stork’s facial expression when the ring was stuck on her claw?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Lanaston Hughes was one of the most important American poets of the he loved century.”可知，Lanaston Hughes 以他的诗最为著名，故选D。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which is the RIGHT order of the following sentences?①The stork found a ring.②The stork met the rabbit.③The stork realized her mistake.④The stork hid the ring with the bandage.⑤The stork wrapped her claw again before gong to the hospital.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“One day, a stork (鹳) saw a beautiful ring.”；第二段中“She hid the ring by bandaging (用绷带包扎) her claws.”；第三段中“but later she ran into the rabbit.”；第四段中“Once the stork got inside her house, she wrapped (包裹) her claws again and again so that the doctor wouldn’t see 【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之记叙文(18 篇)(

questions.stem: The stork fell down because ________.
opts: she was too tired to fly
she put something else on her claw
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“When he was in Grade Eight, he was chosen to be a class poet. His career as a writer began.”可知，他八年级开始，他的写作生涯开始了，故选C。

questions.stem: Which of the following can be put into “.”
opts: two heads are better than one
a friend in need is a friend indeed
questions.expl: 本文讲述了鹳偷兔子成指，说谎失去朋友，最后知错能改的故事。

questions.stem: Langston Hughes was most famous for his ________.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据第二段“She started it when she was in the third grade, in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The idea was that anyone at school who was feeling lonely could sit on the ‘buddy bench’. That let other kids know someone needed a friend.”可知，“伙伴长椅”计划的目的是帮助孤独的孩子交朋友。故选B。

questions.stem: Langston Hughes didn’t like Columbia University because ________.
opts: He was one of the black people.
He wanted to travel and write.
White people wasn’t friendly to him.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“After Langston graduated from high school, he went to Columbia University in New York City, but he didn’t like the university because white people there treated him badly.”可知， Langston 不喜欢哥伦比亚大学因为那里的白人对他很不好，故选D。

questions.stem: Langston Hughes’ career as a writer began ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据倒数第二段“To reduce costs and be eco-friendly, she asked her community to collect bottle caps.”可知，Sammie 的长椅是用可回收材料做的。故选A。

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT true about Langston Hughes?
opts: He read a lot of books in his childhood.
He studied in Columbia University for only one year.
He taught black people to write short stories at different universities.
He died at the age of 65.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据最后一段“Through learning from those who break barriers, we too can make our own potentials come true - to be a powerful force for good.” 通过向那些打破障碍的人学习，我们也可 以实现自己的潜力，成为一股强大的向善力量；可知，作者建议读者学习先驱者，充分发挥潜力。 故选C。

questions.stem: What’s the best title of the passage?
opts: How to be a successful poet
Love reading from an early age
questions.expl: 本文主要讲的就是Langston Hughes 这位伟大的诗人的一生。

questions.stem: What’s the purpose of the Buddy Bench program?
opts: To raise money for sick children.
To help lonely children make friends.
To give old people a seat to have a rest.
To remind others to save our environment.
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据“To cover his terrible action, the terrified boy glued the pieces together discreetly and put the vase back to its place.”可知这个吓坏了的男孩小心翼翼地把碎片粘在一起，把花瓶放回原 处，故此处划线部分意为“小心翼翼地”，和carefully 意义相近。故选C。

questions.stem: Sammie’s benches are made out of ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“The Ford Foundation is still giving money to help poor countries and poor areas.” 可知，Henry Ford 创办基金会，是为了帮助落后的国家和地区。故选A。

questions.stem: What can we learn from Sammie’s work?
opts: It’s easy to become more outgoing.
It’s kind to make a bench for adults.
It’s never too young to make a difference.
It’s hard to overcome personal challenges.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“The man sat and waited excitedly.”可知，年轻人刚开始是激动的；根据“but he could no longer stand the silence”可知，接下来年轻人不开心的，不能忍受；根据“the young man 【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之记叙文(18 篇)(

questions.stem: What’s the best title for the passage?
opts: The ways to help make friends
questions.expl: 本文主要介绍了Sammie 的“伙伴长椅”长椅项目的产生、运作以及这个项目的目的，即帮 助孤独的孩子交朋友。

questions.stem: What is the meaning of the underlined sentence “ Henry Ford put America on wheels” in paragraph 1?
opts: Henry Ford let many Americans have cars.
Henry Ford set up factories that produced wheels.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“When I was a child, my parents read bedtime stories to my sister and me each night. It is one of my favourite childhood memories”可知，作者最喜欢的童年记忆之一是听父母读睡 前故事，故选D。

questions.stem: Which is the right order of the following things according to the passage?a. He set up some factories in order to make cars run fast.b. He set up his company and brought out the first Model T.c. He doubled the payment to make workers work harder.【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之记叙文(18 篇)(
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“His mother was quite clear that her son was lying, because all the windows were closed before she left for work each morning and opened after she returned”可知他的母亲很清楚她的儿 子在撒谎，因为每天早上她上班前所有的窗户都是关着的，回来后再打开，所以当时窗户是关着的， 所以他妈妈知道猫进不来，从而知道他在撒谎。故选C。

questions.stem: Why did Henry Ford give most of this money to the Ford Foundation?
opts: He wanted to help people in poor places.
He hoped his workers could make faster cars.
He used the money to start a charity before his death.
He ordered the Ford Foundation to produce more cars.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“She realized she shouldn't just blame and punish her son for lying. She came up with another idea”以及“This chocolate is a reward for your imagination: a window-opening cat”可知他 妈妈没有惩罚他，而是给他一盒巧克力，奖励他的想象力和修理能力。故选B。

questions.stem: From the article, we can know that Henry Ford was ________.
questions.expl: 结构题。根据全文可知，第一段介绍了作者不喜欢“谈谈你的家庭”这门课；第二、三段阐 述家庭是独特且有趣的，值得深入挖掘。第四、五、六段介绍了母亲制作家谱；第七段总结了英语 中有很多谈论家庭生活的习语。选项C 符合。故选C。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.expl: 本文是一篇记叙文。文章主要讲述了美国发明家福特汽车的创始人Henry Ford 的人生经 历和创立福特汽车的过程。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “discreetly” in Paragraph 1 probably mean?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“He took very good care of this cow and one day when it was ill. He was very worried. He telephoned the vet.”可知他的奶牛生病了，他打电话给兽医。故选D。

questions.stem: Why did mum know that Ben lied?
opts: Because there were no cats in the neighbourhood.
Because Ben could catch the cat,
Because all the windows were closed at that time.
Because all the windows were opened at that time.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“To make me play with friends like other kids, my parents would have to take books away from me”可知，父母阻止作者读书是为了不让她因为读书而失去朋友，故选A。

questions.stem: How did the mother correct Ben’s mistake?
opts: By making chocolate flash in front of him.
By rewarding instead of blaming or punishment.
By making no mention of her son’s mistake only.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“I see reading as an important part of my life, not a hobby to pass my time. For me, reading opens up a whole new world.”可知，阅读为作者打开了一个全新的世界，所以推断，作者认 为阅读是将世界与自己连接的桥梁，故选D。

questions.stem: What do you think of the mother?
questions.expl: 本文介绍了本失手打破妈妈最爱的花瓶，因为害怕惩罚撒谎说是邻居的猫打破的，妈妈用 智慧的方法教会了男孩从此不再撒谎。

questions.stem: One of the writer’s favourite childhood memories was ________.
opts: listening to her parents read bedtime stories
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Team China won 40 gold, 27 silver and 24 bronze medals.”可知，中国队赢得40 枚金牌，27 枚银牌和24 枚铜牌，共计91 枚奖牌。故选D。

questions.stem: Why would the writer’s parents stop her from reading?
opts: Because she might lose her friends because of reading.
Because she liked reading books very much.
Because they wanted her to read her own books.
Because they thought it didn’t help her with study.
questions.expl: 猜测题。根据“The pills should make her better.”以及“How should I give them to her”可知是如 何给奶牛喂药丸，故此处them 指代“药丸”。故选C。

questions.stem: What does the writer think of reading?
opts: A good way to learn new skills.
A favourite hobby in her free time.
An activity that makes her popular.
A bridge between the world and herself.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“How should I give them to her”以及“Put this tube in her mouth, then put the pills in the tube and blow. That’ll make it.”可知兽医给农夫展示如何给奶牛喂药丸。故选B。

questions.stem: From the fourth paragraph, we can learn that an introverted person is ________.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“She apologized to the rabbit and told him the whole story.”可推知，她是后悔自 己不断编谎言去圆前面的谎言，接下来应该是讲诚实的重要性。故选B。

questions.stem: The writer met great people and travelled around the world by ________.
opts: writing letters to the great people
reading books in her chair or on her bed
questions.expl: 本文讲述了作者从小爱好阅读，通过阅读不仅获取了知识，也在内向性格中找到自我认同， 并通过书本开阔了视野，领略到世界的广阔及与人相遇的奇妙。

questions.stem: The farmer asked the vet for help when: his cow ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Late that night, we started our final part of the climb. Nervously we carried on after a short rest. Everyone looked scared.”可知，短暂休息后就继续前进，他们是疲倦且恐惧的。故 选B。 2. 细节理解题。根据“I could not think. The height of the mountain was playing tricks on my mind.”可知， 山的高度使我心神不定。故选D。

questions.stem: The underlined word “them” in Paragraph 3 means ________.
opts: a small box and a long tube
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Twenty-year-old Chinese swimmer Pan Zhanle broke his own world record... ”可 知，年仅22 岁的潘展乐打破了他自己保持的世界记录，由此推断出他很年轻并且很有天赋。故选 C。 【沪教】八上英语·期中·阅读理解之记叙文(18 篇)(

questions.stem: The vet taught the farmer how to ________.
opts: have the cow take the pills
put the tube in his mouth
